arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
base=https://lowcost-europa.duckdns.org
echo "PAGES_BEGIN"
for p in / /pesquisar/?q=hifu /products/cavitacao-rf-vacuum-corpo/ /products/hydrodermoabrasao-aqua-facial-multifuncoes/ /products/pressoterapia-vacuum-drenagem/ /products/hifu/ /products/diodo-laser-remocao-tatuagens-pigmentacao/ /como-funciona/ /afiliados/ /privacidade/ /termos/ /contacto/ /sitemap.xml /robots.txt;do
 code=$(curl -sSL --max-time 12 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$base$p")
 printf 'PAGE=%s CODE=%s\n' "$p" "$code"
 test "$code" = 200
done
echo "AFFILIATE_INVALID_GUARD"
go_code=$(curl -sS --max-time 12 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$base/go/0/")
echo "INVALID_GO_CODE=$go_code"
test "$go_code" = 404
echo "NOINDEX"
curl -sSI --max-time 12 "$base/" | grep -iq '^X-Robots-Tag: noindex'
echo "NOINDEX_HEADER=PASS"
echo "PAGES_END"
